description: What each blockchainnodeengine_v1 operation is authorized as (core OperationIam): the IAM permission the method checks and the smallest predefined role that holds it, as Alchemy's GCP bindings grant them and their live probe suites verify (alchemy-run/alchemy#2753). Discovery documents carry no IAM, so this is the record; correct a method here when a live call disagrees.
